'''Ariavos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At one point he resided on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] where he used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a bounty onto ex-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Brogon]] and his henchmen, who defected and turned to extortion.<ref name="BC" /><ref name="WK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ariavos first appeared in game update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is voice by [[Fred Tatasciore]].

He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event quest series of the Republic players in the game on Ord Mantell.
